system.description:
You gain a mastery of movement, allowing you to cover much greater distance in a shorter amount of time. Until the end of your turn, you gain a +20 bonus to your speed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the bonus to speed by +10. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, while moving you become invisible and only when ending your movement, declaring an attack or casting a jutsu do you become visible. Making an attack after ending invisibility from this jutsu does not grant advantage.
